links.outcome: Comparative performance of lightweight networks versus retinal foundation models on handheld fundus data
links.effect: Lightweight models achieved favorable performance; retinal foundation models pre-trained on conventional fundus data showed limited advantages. Screening AUC 0.9612; fine-grained classification macro-AUC 0.8445.
links.quote: Retinal foundation models, pre‑trained on conventional adult fundus datasets, showed limited performance advantages in this portable imaging scenario.

unlisted_practices: standardized automated image quality assessment to filter ungradable handheld fundus images before AI analysis
two-stage AI screening (abnormality detection then disease classification)

screen.reason: Evaluates an automated image quality control management workflow combined with deep learning screening on a retrospective cohort of handheld fundus photography images.
